transactionIllustration.title: Transaction Illustration
transactionIllustration.description: For those who wish to invest in products offered by PT Equityworld Futures, you may refer to the transaction illustrations below to help you consider more carefully whether you are confident to proceed:

transactionFormula.title: Transaction Calculation Formula
transactionFormula.formula: [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] – [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]

details.label: Contract Size
details.value: US$ 5 per point for stock index periodic rolling contracts, 100 troy ounces for Loco London gold daily rolling contracts, 5,000 troy ounces for Loco London silver daily rolling contracts, 1,000 barrels for Brent Crude Oil (BCO) periodic rolling contracts, and 100,000 for forex daily rolling spot contracts.

details.label: n Lot
details.value: n is the number of lots traded.

details.label: Facility
details.value: Facility Fee: US$ 15 per lot per side (buy or sell). Rollover Facility: US$ 3/lot/night/side for HKK; US$ 2/lot/night/side for JPK; US$ 5/lot/night/side for Gold, Silver, and BCO.

details.label: Total Commission Fee
details.value: Total commission fee is US$ 30 for 1 lot settlement.

details.label: VAT on Facility Fee
details.value: VAT (Value Added Tax) on Facility Fee is 11% of the commission fee, i.e. US$ 1.65/lot/side. Total VAT is US$ 3.3 for 1 lot settlement.

details.label: Overnight / Roll Over Fee
details.value: If the transaction is settled more than one day (overnight), each lot will be charged an overnight/rollover fee plus 11% VAT on the overnight fee (see trading table).

rolloverFee.title: Rollover Facility (overnight fee):
items: Gold, Silver, and BCO: US$ 5 /lot/night/side (buy or sell)
Rollover VAT: 11% VAT on the overnight fee

examples.description: An investor takes a position in HKK5U_BBJ at 25,000 for 2 lots (Open Buy 2 lots), expecting the price to move higher. During the day session the price rises to 25,400 and the investor liquidates all positions at 25,300 (Closed Sell 2 lots).

calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = [ ( US$61,200 / troy ounce – US$61,175 / troy ounce ) x 5,000 troy ounces x 1 lot ] – [ ( US$30 + US$3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
P/L = ( 0.025 / troy ounce x 5,000 / troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US$33.3 )
P/L = [ ( US$61,155 / troy ounce – US$61,175 / troy ounce ) x 5,000 troy ounces x 1 lot ] – [ ( US$30 + US$3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
P/L = ( -0.020 / troy ounce x 5,000 / troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US$33.3 )

examples.title: Example 2 (JPK5U_BBJ)
examples.description: An investor analyzes that JPK5U_BBJ will decline and immediately takes a sell position at 49,850 for 2 lots. Two days later, the investor closes the position when the price is at 49,650.
calculation: P/L = [(Selling Price - Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lot] - [(Fee US$30 + VAT) x n Lot]
P/L = (200 points x US$5 x 2 lots) - US$66.6
Because the trade is held overnight, an overnight (rollover) fee + VAT is charged: [(US$2 + US$0.22) x 2 lots x 2 nights] = US$8.88
Therefore net profit is: P/L = US$1,933.4 - US$8.88 = US$1,924.52

examples.title: Example 3 (XULF)
examples.description: An investor predicts Loco London gold is in an uptrend and plans to take a buy position. The investor buys 2 lots at US$ 4,275.30 / troy ounce. However, the price drops to US$ 4,260.65 / troy ounce and the investor must liquidate 1 lot at US$ 4,265.30 / troy ounce. On the next day, the investor liquidates the remaining lot when the price is at US$ 4,290.20 / troy ounce.
calculation: P/L = [US$(4,265.30 - 4,275.30) / troy ounce x 100 troy ounces x 1 lot] - [US$(30 + 3.3) x 1 lot]
Because the trade is held more than 1 day, an overnight (rollover) fee + VAT is charged: [(US$5 + US$0.55) x 1 lot x 1 night] = US$5.55

directRates.title: DIRECT RATES CATEGORY
directRates.formula: P/L = [(Selling Price-Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lots] – [(Facility Fee + VAT) x n Lot]

indirectRates.title: INDIRECT RATES CATEGORY
indirectRates.formula: P/L = (Selling Price-Purchase Price) / Liquidation Price x Contract Size x Number of Lots

penarikanDana.title: Funds Withdrawal Procedure (Withdrawal)
penarikanDana.description: PT Equityworld Futures ensures that the funds withdrawal process is transparent, efficient, and fully compliant with regulations. Clients may submit a withdrawal request at any time, as long as the requested amount does not exceed the Effective Margin recorded in their daily transaction report (Statement Report).
prosesSteps: Clients submit a withdrawal request via the Withdrawal menu in their live trading account, in accordance with the applicable terms and conditions.
The withdrawal request form must be completed accurately and in full so that the process can run smoothly without delays.
Funds can only be transferred to a bank account under the Client’s own name, as stated in the verified Account Opening documents.
The standard processing time is a maximum of three business days (T+3), but PT Equityworld Futures strives to complete each request within one business day (T+1) as part of its service commitment.

petunjukTransaksi.title: TRADING GUIDELINES
petunjukTransaksi.description: PT Equityworld Futures provides two methods for submitting trading orders: online and by telephone. Before entering the live trading environment, clients are encouraged to first use the simulation features so they can better understand the flow and functions of the online trading system.
petunjukTransaksi.description2: For online transactions, clients will receive an official User ID and Password from PT Equityworld Futures as their primary access credentials to the trading platform.
petunjukTransaksi.onlineRequirements: To be able to trade online, please ensure the following requirements are met:
requirements: Have an active and stable internet connection.

requirements.text: Access the official trading platform via:

requirements: A valid online trading User ID and Password have been issued by PT Equityworld Futures (the Password can be changed by the client for security purposes).
petunjukTransaksi.note: Note: For each transaction, clients can only buy or sell a maximum of 50 lots.

attention.title: Attention:
attention.content: Clients are required to read and understand the terms and conditions of the online trading system as presented on the opening page. By logging into the system and executing transactions, clients are deemed to have accepted all consequences related to such transactions.
